nodes.title: 共享负面提示词 (FLUX 留空)
Debuff 减益批量出图说明 (共18张)
widgets_values:
■ 工作流: Debuff 减益图标批量生成 (FLUX)
   一次 Queue Prompt 出全部 18 张
   预计耗时 95-110 分钟 (M4 Pro)

■ Debuff 序列 (棱形碎玉外框):
   控制系  1-5 stun/frozen/slow/silence/disarm
   持续伤害 6-9 bleed/poison/burn/heart_demon
   削弱系 10-12 atk_down/def_down/speed_down
   修真系 13-18 qi_disorder/qi_deviation/qi_drained/
                  elements_unbalanced/faith_shaken/karma_backlash

■ 风格一致性:
   - 共享 seed 88888888 (fixed)
   - 共享 EmptyLatent 1024x1024
   - 棱形碎玉外框统一,与 Buff 圆形玉佩盲识可分

■ 输出 (每张 2 份):
   output/wuxia_debuff_1024/[name].png  (1024 母版)
   output/wuxia_debuff_64/[name].png    (64 游戏图标)

■ 命名规范 (与 status-effects-system 对齐):
   debuff_icon_[name].png
   由 import_ai_assets.sh 自动回流到
   assets/ui/buff_icons/ (与 Buff 同目录,文件名前缀区分)

■ 单张重抽:
   1. 找到该图标的 KSampler 节点
   2. seed 改成别的数 (如 88888889)
   3. control_after_generate 暂改 randomize
   4. 单独 Queue Prompt 重抽
   5. 满意后改回 fixed

■ 注意:
   FLUX 对棱形/菱形外框可能不如圆形稳定
   若整批外框崩坏,把 Note 提示词模板中 rhomboid 改为
   octagonal 或换回 circular 全部重抽

widgets_values: A minimalist game UI icon for a cultivation wuxia RPG, centered composition. Subject: a single small humanoid head silhouette in the center with three tiny purple star symbols rotating in a circle around the head, suggesting stunned disorientation. The subject occupies about 70 percent of the canvas in the center, with generous empty space around. Behind the subject is a single closed rhomboid diamond-shaped broken jade fragment border standing on its point, with subtle hairline cracks running across the frame edges, uniform thin line weight, completely symmetric along its vertical axis, in cool muted dark gray tone. Pure clean solid white background, no other elements. Flat vector illustration style, painted with traditional Chinese ink wash brushstrokes but extremely simplified for icon use. dark violet purple and dim black color palette only.
